top_signals.title: Hackers disrupt refrigeration systems at European supermarkets
top_signals.summary: A cyberattack on refrigeration systems has disrupted stores run by multiple supermarket chains across several European countries after hackers remotely changed temperature settings on freezers and cooling systems. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
